# Project Cedar launch brief fullmulti20260915
Project Cedar launches on 22 November 2026. Mira Chen leads the project.
The public launch workshop takes place in the North Hall at 10 AM.
The pilot group includes twelve community gardeners. Each gardener receives a printed schedule and a seed tray.
Mira Chen will collect feedback at the workshop and publish a summary on 25 November 2026.
The project studies which native plants thrive in shaded courtyards. The group will compare fern growth and soil moisture every week.
